sides.snippet: To your seed have I given this land, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates
sides.verseText: In that day Yahweh made a covenant with Abram, saying, \"To your seed have I given this land, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates:

sides.snippet: When you come into the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to the borders of it)
sides.verseText: Command the children of Israel, and tell them, When you come into the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to the borders of it),
